UI_QoLforSacriel_ModuleDisabled: Module is disabled in sandbox settings.
UI_QoLforSacriel_EquipmentTogglePresetTo: Toggles this preset between equip and unequip mode.
UI_QoLforSacriel_EquipmentAddAllCurrentP: adds currently worn protective gear and equipped weapon-category items to this preset, clearing anything that was here before
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableMod_Toolt: Master switch for every QoL for Sacriel feature on this page.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DebugLogs_Toolt: Writes extra diagnostic logs for troubleshooting module behavior.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableUIFixes_T: Turns the entire UI Fixes group on or off at runtime.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableSkillFilt: Shows the optional skill list filter in the character info panel.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_SkillFilterIncl: Keeps skills visible when they have some progress but no full level yet.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableWaterDept: Shows per-tile water amount overlay hints while using the Water search focus.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthShowL: When enabled, players with Foraging level above 3 see numeric liters (one decimal) instead of Shallow/Medium/Deep labels.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableHeavyLoad: Plays local hurt feedback when heavy-load damage is actively reducing health.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthOverl: How many tiles around the player are scanned for water amount markers. Default 3, 5+ can affect FPS.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthShall: Per-tile water amount (liters) where overlay becomes Shallow. Valid range: 0-10L. Medium is inferred between shallow and deep.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_WaterDepthDeepM: Per-tile water amount (liters) where overlay becomes Deep. Valid range: 0-10L. Medium is inferred automatically.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableSoundDire: Allows the sound direction visualizer to run at runtime.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_SoundDirectionN: Detailed Sound Direction settings remain on the dedicated QoL Sound Direction page (below). Default off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableDragDrop_: Controls corpse dragging endurance compensation and related drag-drop tweaks.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DragDropFatigue: Starting share of normal endurance loss while dragging a corpse.
Maximum share of normal endurance loss after the ramp completes.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_DragDropRampSec: Seconds it takes for drag fatigue to ramp from start multiplier to max multiplier.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableRestSleep: Adds and manages the Rest Until Sleepy quality-of-life action.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepSleepy: Target fatigue value where automatic resting should stop.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepInterr: Stops automated rest when movement input is detected.
Stops automated rest when panic rises past the configured threshold.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_RestSleepPanicI: Panic value that interrupts automatic rest when panic interrupt is enabled.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableEquipment: Turns the equipment preset system on or off.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentEnable: Enables preset save, toggle, and clear actions in inventory context menu and hotkeys. All items can be added manually, but only armor/weapons are added 'on add all
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentPreset: How many equipment preset slots are exposed to the player.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentHotkey: Capture a keybind per preset. Modifier keys are captured directly in each preset keybind.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EquipmentPreset: Click and press the desired key combination for this preset.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableFurniture: Adds right-click nudge actions for eligible placed furniture.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeE: Multiplier applied to weight-scaled endurance loss when nudging furniture.
Minimum endurance spent on a successful nudge.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeB: When enabled, dropped floor items can block a nudge destination tile.
Block Nudge On Rugs And Carpets
When enabled, rugs and carpets can block a nudge destination tile.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeA: Allows eligible multi-tile furniture to be nudged. Experimental and may fail on edge cases.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_FurnitureNudgeI: Ignores vanilla pickup/place tool requirements for Furniture Nudge actions only.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableLightSwit: Adds a hotkey to toggle the nearest valid light switch.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_LightSwitchTogg: Click and press the desired key combination. Default is Ctrl+F.
Tile radius to search for nearby light switches. Default 1.
When enabled, only light switches in the same room are eligible.
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeParallelW: cannot nudge parallel to nearby wall
UI_QoLforSacriel_FurnitureNudgeRequiresT: cannot nudge furniture that requires tools
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_EnableArmorMood: Reduces discomfort gain while wearing protective gear outside high-effort actions.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ArmorMoodBaseRe: Fraction of discomfort gain removed while the armor effect is active. Default 0.95, use 1.0 for full removal.
UI_QoLforSacriel_Modules_ArmorMoodUpdate: Minimum time between armor discomfort recalculations. To limit fps impact.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_PerformanceN: Note: enabling Sound Direction can reduce FPS, especially in busy areas.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_Enable_Toolt: Master switch for the directional sound overlay.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_UseAmbientCo: Tries to enrich ambient cues using nearby world-sound events when both happen together.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ZMarkerEnabl: Draws a small vertical marker when the sound came from another floor.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_EnableInferr: Adds best-effort zombie sound cues when no direct sound event is available.
Adds best-effort animal sound cues based on nearby animals when no direct sound event is available.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ShowSourceLa: Displays a short text label next to each sound cue.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ShowOutsideH: Shows sounds beyond your hearing radius in white so they can be distinguished from heard sounds.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_ArrowScale_T: Scales the size and offset of the directional arrow indicator.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_TriggerRando: Calls the vanilla random meta ambient trigger for testing sound detection.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_MaxTrackedCu: Maximum number of active sound cues kept in memory at once.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CueDurationM: How long each sound cue remains visible before expiring.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryPlay: Shows world-sound cues sourced from players.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryEnvi: Shows environmental sounds such as wildlife and weather-derived cues.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryAlar: Shows alarms, sirens, generators, and similar alerting sound cues.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryMeta: Shows standalone meta-event cues such as meta wildlife, screams, and other ambient story sounds.
UI_QoLforSacriel_SoundIntel_CategoryUnkn: Shows cues that could not be classified into a known sound group.
